items.question: What happens in the 7-minute Fit-Check?
items.answer: You tell me your budget and what your family needs. I tell you which 3 East condos pass my test, and which ones to skip. No pitch. If I'm not the right person for you, I'll say so.

items.question: Why only the East?
items.answer: Because I can't know every block on the island. In the East I know which stacks get the afternoon sun, which face the expressway, and what each one really sold for. That's the part that saves you money.

items.question: Do you help with HDB flats?
items.answer: No. I only help people buy condos and ECs in the East. If you need an HDB deal or a home outside the East, I'll point you to someone good.

items.question: New launch or resale. Which do you look at?
items.answer: Both. But I judge both the same way: against what real owners paid and sold for. A price list tells you what the developer wants. Past sales tell you what the market will pay.

items.question: What if no condo passes your test?
items.answer: Then I tell you to wait. I'd rather lose a sale than put your family in the wrong home.
